queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Enter one search query per line. These queries will be sent to the enabled AI platforms (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, and Perplexity) to check for your brand's visibility.
queries.prefill:
best search engine
alternative to google
best AI search

brand.title: Brand name
brand.description: The brand name to search for in AI-generated responses and cited sources. The search is case-insensitive.

organicResult.title: Organic results to include
organicResult.description: How many organic search results to include per query. Asking for more than 10 will slow down the Actor.
organicResult.sectionDescription: How many Google organic results do you wish to include?

enableChatGpt.title: Enable ChatGPT Search
enableChatGpt.description: Enable ChatGPT Search to get AI-generated answers from OpenAI's search model. Additional fees apply per successful result via the Google Search Scraper Actor.
enableChatGpt.sectionDescription: Select which AI platforms to monitor for brand visibility. Each enabled platform adds to the processing time and cost. At least one platform should be enabled.

enableAiMode.title: Enable Google AI Mode
enableAiMode.description: Enable Google AI Mode to get Google's AI-generated responses. Additional fees apply per successful result via the Google Search Scraper Actor.

enableAiOverviews.title: Process Google AI Overviews
enableAiOverviews.description: Process Google AI Overviews that appear in search results. No additional cost - the Actor will analyze the AI Overview content and sources for brand mentions.

enablePerplexity.title: Enable Perplexity AI Search
enablePerplexity.description: Enable Perplexity AI to get answers from the Sonar model. Additional fees apply per successful result via the Google Search Scraper Actor.

enableGemini.title: Enable Gemini AI Search
enableGemini.description: Fetches an AI answer from Gemini (gemini.google.com) for every query to compare against other AI platforms.

enableCopilot.title: Enable Copilot AI Search
enableCopilot.description: Fetches an AI answer from Copilot for every query to compare against other AI models.

ownDomains.title: Own domains (to exclude)
ownDomains.description: List your own domains to exclude from source analysis. Sources from these domains will be skipped since you already have presence there.
ownDomains.sectionDescription: Configure which domains to exclude from source analysis. Own domains and competitor domains are filtered out, leaving only third-party sources that represent outreach opportunities.

competitorDomains.title: Competitor domains (to exclude)
competitorDomains.description: List competitor domains to exclude from source analysis. Sources from these domains will be skipped.

ignoreDomains.title: Other domains to exclude
ignoreDomains.description: List competitor domains to exclude. For example domain with user generated content like Quora and Youtube

maxContactsPerDomain.title: Max contacts per domain
maxContactsPerDomain.description: Maximum number of contact leads to scrape from each source domain where the brand isn't mentioned. Higher values increase cost but provide more outreach contacts.
maxContactsPerDomain.sectionDescription: Control how many sources and contacts are processed per query to manage costs.

includeMention.title: Include mentions without backlink
includeMention.description: By default, sources that mention your brand without giving you a backlink are included in the contact search.

department.title: Department to search for leads
department.description: By default, the Actor looks for leads in the marketing department, as they're most likely to work on link building.

enableEmailVerification.title: Email verification
enableEmailVerification.description: When enabled, verifies the email address of each lead extracted during business leads enrichment. Each lead receives an emailVerification object with the verification result and quality assessment.

searchAuthorName.title: Search for author name
searchAuthorName.description: Uses AI to identify the author of the article and find their email address.
searchAuthorName.sectionDescription: Find the author name and article title to personalize your outreach. ($35/1k blog posts)
